'''Dee Dunstan''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared ''[[AG068|A Double Dilemma]]''. His English name comes from [[Darren Dunstan]], the English voice director of {{aniseries|PTS}} at the time. He does not have an official name in the Japanese version.

Dee Dunstan is a reporter who works in [[North Petalburg]]. Due to the town's fascination with [[Norman]], he seems to be eager to report on anything relating to the [[Gym Leader]]. When {{an|May}} came through town with {{Ash}}, {{an|Brock}}, and [[Max]], Dunstan and the other residents of North Petalburg swarmed her after being alerted to her presence by {{OBP|Rose|AG068}}. Ash tried to get noticed as well, but the town was much more interested in hearing from Norman's daughter.

Dunstan kept asking May various questions relating to her aspirations of becoming a {{g|Coordinator}} and was one of the people who pressured her into battling Ash. He also booed Ash whenever he got the upper hand against May.
